_note: The FULL candidate pool the MB-CLS case set was drawn from, committed so the draw is auditable. Discovery: 14 fixed arXiv searches over automated research and the checking of its outputs; an abstract had to mention checking AND automation/agency and be at least 400 characters; anything already cited in a run corpus (model-collapse, e2e-claims) was excluded. 353 survived. The pool is discovery, NOT evidence — the authoritative excerpts are fetched separately by scripts/fetch_source_content.py and hash-anchored.
draw_rule: sorted by sha256('mb-cls-v1' + arxiv_id), first 60 taken. Reproducible from this file; no judgement, no selection for an expected label.
